mappingNote: Adaptation of NIST AI RMF functions for internal platform-risk operations; not NIST endorsement or a claim that platform ranking is itself an AI-RMF implementation.

protocol.name: Observe
protocol.trigger: inside control limits; no official notice

protocol.name: Investigate
protocol.trigger: below control limit or repeated comparable anomaly; no confirming platform state
protocol.stop: return to Observe when data fault or ordinary variation explains signal; escalate only on corroboration

protocol.name: Respond
protocol.trigger: official enforcement/eligibility record or independently reviewed convergent evidence
protocol.stop: close on documented resolution, exhausted route, or owner decision; never infer guaranteed restoration
